data.content_ref: inline:The 'System' property (SRC_003) contradicts the 'Checklist-Task Fit' (SRC_005) by suggesting that the agent is a mere CPU, whereas the 'Fit' implies that the environment (world-type) dictates the agent's (expert vs panel) necessity. This relation is refuted if the 'System' (Checklist + Panel) can be proven to be equally reliable in both open-world and closed-world tasks.
